item.title: Gold Card visa: Cost, eligibility, application timeline, and how to apply — explained
item.description: US President Donald Trump launched the Gold Card visa, a million-dollar fast track to US residency for individuals and companies. Priced at $1 million for individuals and $2 million for corporate sponsors, it offers substantial benefits and allows companies to retain foreign graduates. Applications are now open.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: Trump says US seized ‘largest ever’ oil tanker off Venezuela; dramatic footage shows operators fast-roping aboard — watch
item.description: The United States has seized a large oil tanker off the coast of Venezuela, President Trump announced, marking a significant escalation in pressure on Nicolás Maduro's regime. The tanker, involved in transporting sanctioned oil from Venezuela and Iran, was targeted by a seizure warrant executed by federal agencies.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: FanFan Diddy joke fallout grows as TheStockGuy reports receiving death threats for speaking out
item.description: A joke by FanFan at the Streamer Awards about Kai Cenat and Sean 'Diddy' Combs sparked a major controversy. The incident escalated offline, with one streamer reporting hearing violent threats against FanFan. The reporter, TheStockGuy, is now facing death threats for speaking out, highlighting the dangers of online harassment and the volatility of live-streaming events.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Mountaineer charged in girlfriend’s death says rescue was impossible as she froze on Austria’s highest peak
item.description: A mountaineer faces charges after his girlfriend died on Austria's highest peak. Thomas Plamberger claims he had no choice but to leave Kerstin Gartner to seek help, citing a denied helicopter rescue. Prosecutors allege he abandoned her in freezing conditions, a narrative Plamberger strongly disputes, calling it a tragic accident.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: ‘It’s not blackmail’: Former CIA director reveals how CIA ‘scares’ spies to keep working; old clip goes viral
item.description: Former CIA Director John Brennan's resurfaced interview reveals how instructors used financial leverage to pressure foreign agents into continued espionage. Brennan questioned the ethics, but was told it served national security, not blackmail. Agents' signed acknowledgments of payments could be used to ensure cooperation, a tactic resembling historical intelligence manuals.

item.title: Who is mapletom? The LoL legend whose Twitch channel sparked concern after a 2025 hack
item.description: Taiwanese esports icon Huang Yi-Tang, known as Maple, found his name trending unexpectedly in late 2025 due to a Twitch hack. The incident, which saw his channel broadcast explicit content without his knowledge, disrupted his quiet streaming presence. Despite the chaos, his loyal fanbase demonstrated their enduring support, highlighting Maple's continued influence in the esports scene.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: “There are serious security issues”: Elon Musk opens up on Katie Miller podcast about fear after Charlie Kirk’s assassination
item.description: Tech mogul Elon Musk has significantly reduced public appearances, citing Charlie Kirk's recent killing as a stark warning. Musk revealed that speaking openly now feels perilous, with even a minor misstep potentially proving fatal. This heightened security concern has also prompted Barstool Sports founder Dave Portnoy to bolster his personal security measures, reflecting a growing unease among public figures.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is Japan’s top Twitch streamer, Junichi Kato? Inside Unko-chan’s dating life with adult star, career, and marriage controversy
item.description: Japanese livestreamer Junichi Kato, known as Unko-chan, is in the spotlight. A dating controversy involving adult actress Ai Hongo unfolded. Kato was photographed with Hongo while married. Hongo later revealed they were dating and Kato had claimed divorce. Kato admitted to an affair and announced his divorce. He is now publicly dating Hongo.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: After 300 years, Colombia retrieves its first pieces of the San José, the $17 billion ‘holy grail of shipwrecks’
item.description: Colombia has recovered the first artefacts from the San José galleon, a 1708 shipwreck long dubbed the “holy grail of shipwrecks.” The cannon, porcelain and macuquinas were raised under a scientific project that aims to study, not salvage, a trove valued in the billions. The find adds new depth to an ongoing legal battle and to centuries of fascination with the lost treasure.

item.title: UK report says Indian-origin parents may be aborting female foetuses
item.description: UK government analysis reveals a significant imbalance in birth sex ratios among Indian-origin families, with 113 males per 100 females for third or subsequent births. This anomaly suggests potential sex-selective abortions, with an estimated 400 such cases occurring in England and Wales between 2017 and 2021. Officials state sex-selective abortion is illegal and will not be tolerated.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: Peak philanthropy: Jeff Bezos’ ex-wife MacKenzie Scott donates $7 billion in a single year
item.description: Billionaire MacKenzie Scott has generously donated nearly $7.2 billion in the past year, pushing her lifetime contributions past $26 billion. Her latest wave of 225 grants supports vital areas like education, climate action, and community well-being, with significant funding directed towards organizations aiding underserved populations and expanding opportunities for students.

item.title: Did JD Vance and Usha have a fight in a restaurant? Here is the truth
item.description: Rumours of a public spat between US Vice President JD Vance and his wife, Usha, were fueled by a circulating photo. Vance has since debunked the image, calling it AI-generated and sarcastically dismissing the notion of a public argument. The couple remains unfazed by online speculation, focusing on their family.

item.title: ‘UFO sighting could be …’: Elon Musk reveals the shocking truth about aliens
item.description: Tech mogul Elon Musk has weighed in on UFO sightings, asserting that neither he nor SpaceX has encountered any evidence of alien visitors. He suggests most unexplained aerial phenomena have terrestrial origins, like advanced military projects or mundane objects. While acknowledging the ongoing search for extraterrestrial life, Musk emphasizes the need for concrete proof over speculation.

item.title: 'Would have worked on my companies'! Elon Musk says Doge was 'somewhat successful' — Would Tesla CEO take the leadership again?
item.description: Elon Musk downplayed the achievements of the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), a cost-cutting initiative he led for Donald Trump, stating it achieved only limited gains before folding. Musk expressed regret over the role, citing backlash against him and Tesla, and indicated he would not repeat the experience.
